quest.title: How to Make Friends
quest.description: Outside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, a Scion of the Canopy seems to be troubled about something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd suggest you focus on the comforting.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Hmm... You do speak sense. That poor child has been terrified enough. Alright. Let's go calm him down first...

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Come along, then. From the look of you, you must be an experienced adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: With the two of us there, those thieves won't dare try anything. And don't worry about payment. I know the Guild's rules, and I'll follow them.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: That little one just loves eating Candlecap Mushrooms... And if I recall, lots of them grow under the tree over there. Why don't you start by picking some?

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: I'll be gathering Candlecap Mushrooms on the other side. Once you're done with yours, let's meet up on the cliff near the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: That's where the little Saurian usually takes a break. Perhaps we can find him there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go teach those Treasure Hoarders a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: You're willing to come along? Thank you! And you'd be a big help, too — I can tell you're an experienced adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: I'll be sure to pay you as the Adventurers' Guild rules stipulate. Let's go then — we'll show those scoundrels.

talks.objective: Go to the cliffside to look for Tlamot

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: This is where he normally hangs out, but there's not a trace of him today...

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: He must've hidden after that scare.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Should we go searching for him?

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: ...Nah. Let's leave him in peace for a while. We'll just leave the mushrooms here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've got experience, I see...

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: In taking care of that kid? Definitely. I've been looking after him for a while now, so I know he's a sensitive sort. Even the sight of strangers might spook him.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Only after I fed him for a long time was he willing to approach me... But I doubt he'll be coming out any time soon, now that those villains have made a mess of everything.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: We'll need to leave him alone for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming along. Here's the reward.

choices.text: It's just a pity that we couldn't see him.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Don't worry, he remembers those who've done right by him. When the time is right, he will definitely come to see us.

choices.text: I'd love to have met that little Yumkasaurus.

talks.objective: Teach the Treasure Hoarders a lesson

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Hmph. Let's see them dare to hurt my little Yumkasaurus ever again, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Feels like there's been some sort of misunderstanding...

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Don't listen to their pretty words. Why, I saw them tie a rope to that poor Yumkasaurus's tail with my own eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Who knows what might have happened if I hadn't shown up when I had.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Thanks for your aid, in any case. Here's your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: It's just a shame they fled so fast. If we'd caught them, we could put an end to their troublemaking once and for all!

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: That poor little Yumkasaurus... That does it. I'll show them. I'll show those scoundrels!

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: You can run, you louts, but you can't hide!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: You're... a traveler from afar, then? Greetings to you — though I fear I cannot extend any hospitality to you beyond that.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Those wretched Treasure Hoarders were aiming to catch that little Yumkasaurus again. Fortunately, I was on hand to chase them off.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: But the poor thing's been scared stiff. He won't come any closer no matter how I call out.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: No matter. I've found their hideout. I'm going to teach them a lesson, and once I do, I'll have 'em lashed to a tree, and lashed with one too!

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Also, I'll have to find something tasty to comfort that poor little frightened Yumkasaurus...

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: ...Shh. Look over there. He's waiting for us.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
dialogues.text: ...Woo? Mmwoo...?

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Come here, kiddo. We're not gonna hurt ya.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
dialogues.text: Mwoo? Mmmmrawr...

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: I'm Tlamot. Remember me? I'm the one who gave you those delicious treats before.

choices.text: #And I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Roar... Rawrrrr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You play with the happy Yumkasaurus for a while. It seems he's in a much better mood...

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Raar! Oroo, rrooh!

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: #This... Hey, {NICKNAME}, looks like he sees you as a friend already! We both got gifts too.

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks a lot.

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Rawr! Rawrrr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The little Yumkasaurus happily circles you twice before turning and diving into the woods once more.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Looks like he's gone home. Just hope he doesn't run into any more of those scoundrels.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Let's head back as well. Here, take these as compensation.

choices.text: Two rounds of compensation for one commission.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Well, then you'd best keep the share you got from our little Yumkasaurus well. As for what I gave you... Haha, just spend it on whatever you want.

choices.text: Well, this was a profitable excursion.
And I found some of said delicious treats.

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Friend, thank you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you!

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Friend! Friend! Good! Good! See you again!

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: #We meet again, {NICKNAME}. Well, then, what do you say to lending me a hand, just like last time?

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Those Treasure Hoarders never learn their lesson, do they? If we leave them be, they'll only be emboldened to continue doing evil.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: The little Yumkasaurus is safe for now, but he's still a young 'un. He still needs more care...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd suggest you focus on the comforting.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Alright. That'll cheer him up, I hope.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Those Treasure Hoarders shouldn't come looking for trouble with both of us around.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Let me think for a moment... please go to the tree over there and pick two fresh Candlecap Mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Once you've gathered them, let's meet up at the cliff near the Stadium again. Those Treasure Hoarders won't try anything funny with you there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go teach those Treasure Hoarders a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: No problem. Those unrepentant Treasure Hoarders just set up a new camp — I've marked it out.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: I'll pay you based on Adventurers' Guild rules. Let's get going, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Ah, he's gone... Oh well. Let's just leave the Candlecap Mushrooms here.

choices.text: It's just a pity that we couldn't see him.

response.speaker: Timid Little Yumkasaur
response.text: Rawr! Rawrrr! Rawr...

choices.text: Hmm? I think I hear something.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Let's just let him be for now. Maybe he'll be willing to come closer to us once he's grown a bit.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Regardless, the important thing is that he's living a happy life.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Hey there— We're heading off!

choices.text: We're heading off!

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: Ah yes, take this. You deserve this much as thanks for your help.

response.speaker: Tlamot
response.text: I do hope that kid grows up soon — that way, he can just send those Treasure Hoarders flying with a couple of kicks!

choices.text: See you next time!

choices.text: It's a great gift!

dialogues.text: Haha, then you'd best take care of the Embercore Flower he gave you, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These should do it... Let's go look for Tlamot.

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: This is the Treasure Hoarders' camp. C'mon. Time to teach them a lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Startled Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: You, again!? I told you before, we just wanted to pet that little Saurian!

dialogues.speaker: Tlamot
dialogues.text: Enough! You really think I can't see the rope in your hand!?

dialogues.speaker: Exasperated Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Come on, bro! We bought this from your tribe... It's for bungee jumping!

dialogues.speaker: Startled Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Hey! Stop hitting me, please! I'm going, I'm going!
